beats.text: In the United States, 33.2% of working women are part-time. In the Netherlands, it's 77.3%.
This counts anyone working less than 35 actual weekly hours.
In the Netherlands, short workweeks define daily life for 77.3% of employed women.
Germany also stays high, where 60.6% of women work part-time.
At the other end, Mongolia has 6.2%, the UAE has 5.8%, and Poland is the world's lowest at 0.5%.
What percentage of women work part-time in your country?
